verdict.rationale: The README documents in-agent marketplace install commands (`/plugin marketplace add kaankiziltug/logo-design-skill` then `/plugin install logo-design@logo-design-skill`), plus manual-copy and upload alternatives. It explicitly says to start a new session, where the agent picks the skill up from its description. missing for 10: a true single-command install (the marketplace path takes two steps), a package-manager one-liner, independent or hands-on confirmation that the skill activates in the next session.
